PATCH /api/partner/accounts/[account_id]/locations/[location_id]: a partner updates one of their

POST /api/song-request/my-token
Returns the authenticated DJ's stable per-DJ song-request token, generating
one if it is somehow missing. This token is what the song-request QR encodes;
the public resolver maps it to the DJ's soonest upcoming event at scan time.

gaps.text: Some of the code groups and API actions are used by no page this map can follow (background jobs, webhooks, other apps, or calls built at runtime), so they belong to no section.
Some of the components with an id are rendered by no page this map can follow (a page outside the menu, a screen opened at runtime, or unused), so they are listed under their code only.
Some links in the code are missing: imports of the product's own code that resolve to no file, and calls to /api/… that match no route handler here.
